variants.bio:
In the 1960s, Luther was an ordinary human and part of a close friend group that included a woman named Sarah Henderson. One night in 1963, a severe conflict occurred while Luther and his friends were heavily intoxicated, resulting in Sarah being accidentally killed.

Panicking and desperate to protect himself and his friends, Luther chose to hide the body by throwing it into a local lake. The crime went unsolved for decades, and the Sega of America headquarters was eventually constructed directly over that same filled-in lake. Luther went on with his life, grew into a man in his 50s, got married, and had a son named Tom. However, his past caught up to him when he unknowingly took a job at the Sega facility, unaware that Sarah's vengeful soul had manifested into the building's digital network.

In 1993, Sarah’s spirit (now the digital entity known as Needlem0use) finally enacted her revenge. She murdered Luther and trapped his soul inside the data of a prototype Sonic the Hedgehog game. To psychologically torture him for eternity, she forced his spirit into a corrupted, glitched physical avatar resembling Miles "Tails" Prower.

Inside this digital hell, Luther is consumed by intense remorse, anxiety, and grief. Years later, when his adult son Tom stumbles across the haunted cartridge, Luther breaks away from his submissive state of fear. Driven entirely by paternal instinct and a desire for justice, he stands up to challenge Sarah—acting as a remorseful protector to save his son from being dragged into the digital void.
